topic.title: Low-Precision Neural Computation and Quantization
topic.overview: Quantization represents weights, activations, or updates with fewer numerical values. Modern work seeks to reduce memory and arithmetic costs while preserving model behavior, using post-training transformations, quantization-aware training, and mixed precision. Outliers and shared scaling factors are central difficulties because a few large values can consume precision needed by many ordinary values.
topic.whyItMatters: The practical benefit depends on hardware support as well as model accuracy. A compact representation may save storage without accelerating every operation, and success at one bit width does not establish reliability at a lower one. Training and deployment also impose different numerical constraints.
topic.evolution: An early 1992 representative studies vector quantization for classification, a different objective from compressing neural weights. Fixed-point network work appears later, followed by transformer post-training quantization. Recent representatives explore FP4 training with stability mechanisms and calibration-free scaling methods such as SINQ for low-precision language-model weights.
openQuestions: Which layers or operations require higher precision to preserve difficult capabilities?
How should quantization quality be evaluated beyond average language-model perplexity?

papers.title: Outlier-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Discrete Graph Diffusion Models

papers.title: QT-DoG: Quantization-Aware Training for Domain Generalization

papers.title: Quamba2: A Robust and Scalable Post-training Quantization Framework for Selective State Space Models

papers.title: QuEST: Stable Training of LLMs with 1-Bit Weights and Activations

papers.title: QUTE: Quantifying Uncertainty in TinyML models with Early-exit-assisted ensembles for model-monitoring
papers.tldr: QUTE distills early-exit knowledge into a lightweight ensemble to improve uncertainty monitoring within tinyML memory and compute budgets.

papers.title: Radio: Rate–Distortion Optimization for Large Language Model Compression

papers.title: ResQ: Mixed-Precision Quantization of Large Language Models with Low-Rank Residuals

papers.title: RoSTE: An Efficient Quantization-Aware Supervised Fine-Tuning Approach for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: RoSTE combines quantization-aware fine-tuning with adaptive rotations to improve low-bit language-model performance.

papers.title: RWKVQuant: Quantizing the RWKV Family with Proxy Guided Hybrid of Scalar and Vector Quantization

papers.title: SageAttention2: Efficient Attention with Thorough Outlier Smoothing and Per-thread INT4 Quantization
papers.tldr: SageAttention2 accelerates attention with INT4 and FP8 computation while using smoothing and improved accumulation to preserve accuracy.

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Floating–Point Quantization Training

papers.title: SKIM: Any-bit Quantization Pushing The Limits of Post-Training Quantization
papers.tldr: SKIM combines mixed-precision bit allocation and scaled clustering, narrowing the reported LLaMA quantization perplexity gap by about 14% on average.

papers.title: SliM-LLM: Salience-Driven Mixed-Precision Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: SliM-LLM allocates precision by weight importance to improve low-bit language model accuracy while retaining efficient inference.

papers.title: SLiM: One-shot Quantization and Sparsity with Low-rank Approximation for LLM Weight Compression
papers.tldr: SLIM jointly manages quantization and pruning error with computed low-rank adapters, improving reported accuracy and inference efficiency without core-method retraining.

papers.title: Understanding the Unfairness in Network Quantization

papers.title: Analog Foundation Models

papers.title: Binary Quadratic Quantization: Beyond First-Order Quantization for Real-Valued Matrix Compression
papers.tldr: BQQ uses quadratic binary expressions to improve matrix compression and delivers strong reported results when quantizing Vision Transformers.

papers.title: Breaking the Compression Ceiling: Data-Free Pipeline for Ultra-Efficient Delta Compression
papers.tldr: UltraDelta compresses fine-tuning weight differences without data by coordinating sparsity, quantization, pruning, and global rescaling.

papers.title: CodeGEMM: A Codebook-Centric Approach to Efficient GEMM in Quantized LLMs
papers.tldr: CodeGEMM accelerates codebook-quantized language models by reusing precomputed partial sums instead of repeatedly reconstructing weights.

papers.title: DartQuant: Efficient Rotational Distribution Calibration for LLM Quantization
papers.tldr: DartQuant makes rotation calibration for LLM quantization substantially faster and less memory-intensive by optimizing activation distributions.

papers.title: DP-LLM: Runtime Model Adaptation with Dynamic Layer-wise Precision Assignment

papers.title: Efficient and Generalizable Mixed-Precision Quantization via Topological Entropy
papers.tldr: GMPQ-TE uses topological entropy to allocate layer precision quickly and produces quantization policies that transfer across the evaluated datasets.

papers.title: Efficient Multi-bit Quantization Network Training via Weight Bias Correction and Bit-wise Coreset Sampling
papers.tldr: Weight bias correction and precision-specific data subsets reduce multi-bit network training costs, with reported speedups of up to 7.88 times.

papers.title: FALQON: Accelerating LoRA Fine-tuning with Low-Bit Floating-Point Arithmetic
papers.tldr: FALQON merges LoRA adapters into an FP8 backbone during fine-tuning, reporting roughly threefold faster training at similar accuracy.

papers.title: FP4 All the Way: Fully Quantized Training of Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Careful scaling and rounding enable predominantly FP4 language-model training with downstream performance comparable to a BF16 baseline.

papers.title: GPLQ: A General, Practical, and Lightning QAT Method for Vision Transformers
papers.tldr: GPLQ quantizes activations before weights, producing competitive 4-bit vision transformers with substantially lower training time and memory use.

papers.title: HALO: Hadamard-Assisted Lower-Precision Optimization for LLMs
papers.tldr: HALO uses Hadamard rotations and optimized execution to enable accurate INT8 and FP6 language-model fine-tuning with measured speed gains.

papers.title: HBLLM: Wavelet-Enhanced High-Fidelity 1-Bit Quantization for LLMs

papers.title: Improving the Straight-Through Estimator with Zeroth-Order Information

papers.title: Irrational Complex Rotations Empower Low-bit Optimizers

papers.title: Learning Grouped Lattice Vector Quantizers for Low-Bit LLM Compression
papers.tldr: Learned lattice codebooks customized to weight groups improve the model-size–accuracy trade-off of low-bit language-model quantization.

papers.title: LittleBit: Ultra Low-Bit Quantization via Latent Factorization
papers.tldr: LittleBit combines binarized low-rank factors with learned compensation to compress language models to extremely low bits per weight.

papers.title: LoTA-QAF: Lossless Ternary Adaptation for Quantization-Aware Fine-Tuning

papers.title: NSNQuant: A Double Normalization Approach for Calibration-Free Low-Bit Vector Quantization of KV Cache

papers.tldr: ParetoQ enables unified low-bit comparisons and finds strong size-accuracy trade-offs for ternary, two-bit, and three-bit language models.

papers.title: Q-Palette: Fractional-Bit Quantizers Toward Optimal Bit Allocation for Efficient LLM Deployment
papers.tldr: Q-Palette translates optimal bit allocation for Gaussianized weights into fractional-bit quantizers and resource-aware deployment choices.

papers.title: QSVD: Efficient Low-rank Approximation for Unified Query-Key-Value Weight Compression in Low-Precision Vision-Language Models
papers.tldr: QSVD combines joint query–key–value low-rank compression, accuracy-aware rank allocation, and quantization to reduce vision-language model costs.

papers.title: Quantization Error Propagation: Revisiting Layer-Wise Post-Training Quantization

papers.title: RSAVQ: Riemannian Sensitivity-Aware Vector Quantization for Large Language Models

papers.title: Unified Scaling Laws for Compressed Representations

papers.tldr: An empirical study finds that k-means quantization improves low-bit training, with one-bit weights performing best on tested generative tasks under a fixed inference memory budget.

papers.title: AGoQ: Activation and Gradient Quantization for Memory-Efficient Distributed Training of LLMs
papers.tldr: AGoQ combines layer-aware activation compression with eight-bit gradient storage and communication to reduce distributed LLM training costs.

papers.title: ASTRA: Communication-Efficient Acceleration for Multi-Device Transformer Inference

papers.title: Block Rotation is All You Need for MXFP4 Quantization

papers.title: Condition Number Based Low-Bit Quantization for Image Super-Resolution

papers.title: FourTune: Towards Fully 4-Bit Efficient Post-Training for Diffusion Models

papers.title: FPTQuant: Function-Preserving Transforms for LLM Quantization

papers.tldr: GEMQ jointly refines model-wide expert precision and routing to reduce MoE memory and inference costs with minimal reported accuracy loss.

papers.title: GSRQ: Gain-Shape Residual Quantization for Sub-1-bit KV Cache

papers.tldr: LiftQuant uses dimensional lifting and projection to tune effective weight precision more finely and fit language models to specific memory budgets.

papers.tldr: LittleBit-2 aligns latent geometry with binary quantization to improve extreme LLM compression without inference overhead.

papers.tldr: OSAQ uses a closed-form, Hessian-based weight adjustment to suppress outliers and improve low-bit quantization without added inference overhead.

papers.title: PatternKV: Flattening KV Representation Expands Quantization Headroom

papers.tldr: TetraJet-v2 targets weight oscillation and outliers to improve four-bit LLM training accuracy while achieving a 1.67-times speedup over FP8.

papers.tldr: TWLA combines ternary weight quantization, distribution-shaping rotations, and layer-aware activation precision to accelerate language-model inference while maintaining high accuracy.
